dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The mid-dorsal region displays several irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped rings with sharp, jagged high-contrast perimeters. The gradient transitions abruptly from a dark charcoal base to a light grey or white boundary, with the most prominent rings showing uneven thickness and pixel-level serration along their outer edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of small, solid light-intensity pixel clusters located primarily on the lower lateral flank and near the neck. These lack internal gradients and appear as isolated, asymmetrical white flecks against the darker dorsal coat.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal-mid rings form an obtuse triangle. The distance between the two most dorsal rings is approximately equal to the distance from the mid-point of those two to a third, more ventral-lateral ring, creating a stable geometric pattern.
